provenance.chassis: DCP-SC-28P User Manual - unit height is 1U (1.77 in); width and depth taken from the DCP-R chassis the family shares (440 x 505mm)
provenance.column-pitch: raw connection points jitter between 13.85 and 14.80mm, which put ports 7/9 and 8/10 into a 0.15mm overlap that lint L13 caught. Each RJ45 group is therefore fitted to a uniform pitch across its span - 14.32mm left, 14.34mm right - and the drawing jitter discarded
provenance.connector-choice: rj45-hd (14.0mm) is used rather than rj45-shielded (15.8mm) because the measured 14.3mm column pitch cannot accommodate the latter
provenance.port-count: the recovered layout confirms the model name - 24 RJ45 on a 14.3mm column pitch plus 4 LC duplex, i.e. 28 ports, and a separate PROBE
provenance.port-families: DCP-SC-28P User Manual R14.0 A section 2.2 lists the shelf controller's ports as 1x RS232, 1x ETH0, 24x RJ-45 1G Ethernet, 4x SFP+ 10G Ethernet and 1x QSFP-DD probe. Its NEBS warnings address the RJ-45 block as ETH1-12 plus ETH17-28 and section 8.7 calls the optical pair ETH13-16, so the numbering is one 1-28 series with the SFP+ cages in the middle of it, not two rows. The front-view figure agrees - the cages sit two over two between the RJ45 blocks, under silkscreen boxes reading 13/14 and 15/16
provenance.port-identification: RJ45 columns carry one connection point per port; the LC columns carry two about 6.4mm apart, one per fiber, which is what distinguishes them
provenance.port-positions: stencil ShapeSheet connection points, stored by Visio as fractions of shape width/height and resolved against the 19-inch rack width
provenance.probe-port: QSFP-DD, from the same list. Measured off the front-view figure against the RJ45 height it is about 19.7 x 10.6mm, i.e. a QSFP-family cage and not the SFP+ one an earlier revision drew. Placed on the centre the stencil recovered, so only the aperture changed
provenance.psu-orientation: photo - both modules are fitted the same way round, fan inboard of the inlet, so the C14 sits at the far right on PSU-2 and inboard on PSU-1. They are not mirrored
provenance.psu-part: label - Gospower G1251-0550WNA, P/N CRPS0550-AH, and the fan sticker reads 550W Platinum CRPS. So the module is a standard CRPS 1U part at 73.5 x 40 x 185, not the 84mm-wide estimate taken from the racked photo, and both bays sit flush to the chassis edges
provenance.rear-layout: photo IMG_2181 of racked DCP-R units - PSU with integrated fan and C14 inlet at each end, mirrored; honeycomb vent panel across the centre; management block right of centre. Block positions are approximate to about 3mm - the photo has uncorrected perspective and partial cable occlusion, so it fixes the structure and order but not exact millimetres
provenance.rear-mgmt-block: none. The SC-28P carries no rear management ports - its manual places only power and fan units in the back panel, and its ETH0 and RS232 are on the front. An earlier revision copied the DCP-R rear here by mistake; the vent now spans what that block wrongly occupied
provenance.sfp-media: SFP+ 10G, from the same list. The stencil could only show LC duplex because the figure's cages are fitted with LC optics; the cage itself is SFP+ and the ports are now modelled as such rather than as the bare `sfp` family token
provenance.side-top-bottom: IMG_2188 shows the lid, so these now carry the real finish - a light silver body with the black front panel wrapping about 12.7mm (half an inch) back along every face. Still no vents, screws or lid labels - the photo shows the finish and the panel depth but not those details, so they are left out rather than invented
